note: Famous organ records for 'Build it' (lessons/organ-compare.qmd and the organ intro pages). Each checked 2026-11-26: title and channel from YouTube's oEmbed; most video ids from the songs' Wikipedia articles (their external links). The 'build' registrations are starting points made on this page, not the players' documented settings.

videos.title: Booker T. & The MG's - Green Onions (Official Audio)
videos.what: Booker T. Jones on a Hammond (Wikipedia names him among famous Hammond players for this record). Listen for the short, percussive chords and the riff over a 12-bar blues.

videos.title: A Whiter Shade of Pale
videos.what: Matthew Fisher's Hammond line (Wikipedia, 'Hammond organ'). A smooth sustained registration over a slow-moving bass: no percussion bite.

videos.title: PROCOL HARUM - A Whiter Shade Of Pale - promo film #1 (Official Video)
videos.song: A Whiter Shade of Pale (promo film)
videos.what: The same record with the band on film: watch the organist's hands stay on held chords.

videos.title: Light My Fire (2017 Remaster)
videos.what: Ray Manzarek on a Vox Continental (Wikipedia, 'Vox Continental'), with a Rhodes Piano Bass for the bass line. The long organ solo is the Continental's bright, buzzy tone.

videos.title: 96 Tears (Mono)
videos.what: Named among Continental records in Wikipedia, 'Vox Continental'. A thin, reedy two-chord riff, no percussion.

videos.title: Orchestral Manoeuvres In The Dark - Enola Gay (Official Music Video)
videos.what: Wikipedia: OMD used the Vox Jaguar, a cheaper relative of the Continental, on this record. Compare the same divide-down tone in a synth-pop setting.

videos.title: Incense And Peppermints
videos.what: Wikipedia ('Farfisa'): the Farfisa is the main instrument on this record. Bright flute-and-string tabs with vibrato.

videos.title: Rock Lobster
videos.what: Kate Pierson played a Compact Deluxe (Wikipedia, 'Farfisa'); that it is the organ on this track is UNVERIFIED.

videos.title: Astronomy Domine
videos.what: Richard Wright started on a Combo Compact (Wikipedia, 'Farfisa'); that it is the organ on this track is UNVERIFIED.

videos.title: Ch. M. Widor plays his Toccata from V Symphony Op. 42 No. 1
videos.what: The composer at Saint-Sulpice, Paris (linked from Wikipedia, 'Symphony for Organ No. 5'). Full organ: principals, mixtures and reeds coupled. The year is the usual date of this recording (UNVERIFIED).

videos.title: Kalevi Kiviniemi plays Widor's "Toccata" at St.Ouen, Rouen, France
videos.what: The same piece on another big French organ (linked from Wikipedia). Compare the two rooms and reed choruses.

videos.title: J.S. Bach : Toccata and Fugue in D minor BWV 565 / Liene Andreta Kalnciema live at Riga Cathedral
videos.song: Toccata and Fugue in D minor, BWV 565
videos.artist: J. S. Bach, played by Liene Andreta Kalnciema
videos.what: A principal chorus with pedal; how this organist registers it is not documented here.
